messages.subject: Model fit evaluation
parts:
Hi All, 

I have done some mixed-effect conditional logistic regression models with INLA, and I am trying to determine the best way to evaluate model fit using CPO, PO, or the marginal likelihood. I'm not entirely sure these measures are best for models with large numbers of strata as well as random intercepts and slopes. If these measures are appropriate, is there an ideal criteria for evaluating fit? 

Thanks in advance, 
Ben
